market_summary: Ahead of the London/New York session overlap, all six tracked assets are exhibiting low-volatility consolidation within or adjacent to their session Value Areas. Precious metals and FX pairs are suppressed below VWAP and EMA50 baselines but lack RVOL > 2.0 breakout volume to confirm continuation, with EURUSD and GBPUSD printing unconfirmed sweeps of session lows. US100 and BTCUSD remain tightly coiled mid-channel inside their Value Areas. Disciplined execution dictates a universal HOLD across all symbols pending directional expansion during the New York session.
